checks: Actual hidden PiP with width/height present: Remember last reuses position and size after app/native close; Standard resets both each open; mode switch applies next open

Four native selects preserve Default/explicit choices; real Python host restart keeps file-backed mode but first open resets native bounds; opener reload also starts standard, then remembers; no browser storage
Real user-activated Document PiP opens prompt-local table with external CSP styles, no inner frame/close and selected On fill

Owner-resolved Web roles/canvas/controls/tables/popovers/quotas and WCAG text contrast match despite opposite PiP media; Default/Classic/Web round trips, media-only events, compact/narrow focus and one SSE preserve keyed state without browser storage
Quota orientation: authenticated fourth select, same-period Accounts/Watch/open PiP, exhausted empty bar, independent USD/CCost, retained nodes, light/dark narrow/zoom, unchanged source and one SSE

Parenthesized whole-session suffix stays visible before/after title ellipsis; canonical newest-three history, keyboard/click disclosure and shared scroll preserve every running row without content-driven resizing or second SSE

Both single first cells edge-anchor Session and natural-width parenthesized cost; short/long/fallback titles, all display states, live identity, 3 widths, enlarged font/CSS zoom, themes and units preserve suffixes without page overflow

Native pointer/keyboard disclosure grows height once only for new vertical overflow; achieved outer/inner bounds fit rows and collapse restores; existing-scroll, fit, narrow horizontal-only, manual bounds, refused/unsupported/unchanged clamp and SSE never cause repeated resizing

Five real DOM refresh/revaluation cycles retain prompt/session figures and exact card heights without retry/refresh labels in active/earlier cards; virtual sustained delay, unavailable source and recovery remain explicit
Intrinsic metric/header minima grow/shrink with content, empty colspan does not distort, only Session ellipsizes; failed reads retain figures quietly and one ten-minute notice clears on recovery
Navigation, existing-opener return, live theme/USD propagation keep Mini and exactly one EventSource

Compact opening and higher-scale browser clamps keep reachable independent scroll regions; enlarged 5/3 fits at 100/150%, 6/4 scroll; centered headers, semantic data alignment, canonical separate daily summary
Classic/Web light/dark styles, long account labels, primary-only six-account content without page overflow
Keyboard summary focus/activation and user-activated native PiP resize remain usable
With main document actually hidden and PiP visible, real SSE preserves final prompt-local completion metrics and updates empty/recovery without rAF
Shipped controller attaches/fetches the existing absolute same-origin ICO on open/reopen; owner icon and single SSE unchanged (not OS icon proof)
Native API replacement, browser-owned close, main toggle, reopen and main reload synchronize Off; no auto-open
Real terminal shutdown reaches open Mini as not live
limitations: Headless Chromium only; no physical/native X, native return/replacement chrome, minimized-opener restoration, always-on-top OS geometry or screen-reader proof.
